mixed.description: Mixed traffic without lane discipline. Parallel straight one-way roads, 1,000 m long, 10.5 m wide (3 lanes), 25 m apart, speed limit 13.9 m/s, no junctions. One road for every 125 vehicles asked for (8, 24 and 40 roads for 1,000, 3,000 and 5,000 vehicles). Each road starts with 125 vehicles of the Bengaluru vehicle mix in three files at 12 m/s and has a demand of 6,000 vehicles an hour of the same mix, which replaces the vehicles that leave. Traffic is busy but flowing: there is no signal and no queue.

cars-only.description: Cars only, single file. Parallel straight one-way roads, 2,000 m long, 3.5 m wide (1 lane), 25 m apart, speed limit 13.9 m/s, no junctions. One road for every 50 vehicles asked for (20, 60 and 100 roads). Each road starts with 50 cars spaced evenly at 13 m/s and has a demand of 1,200 cars an hour.
